title: nan
authors: Famili A.; Stavrou A.; Wang H.; Park J.-M.
key_contribution: Presents iDROP, an ultrasonic acoustic beacon-based 3D localization scheme with optimized beacon placement for indoor drone navigation in GPS-denied environments.
